baseline.feedback: no local busy state or spinner
baseline.stateRisk: catalog hydration changed the inventory before the filter result became clear

rootCause: Client-computable binary filters called router.push and waited for a route render instead of updating the existing catalog locally.
The pending indicator was rendered by the same expensive React update as the result computation, so it could itself be delayed.
Implicit feature defaults on semantic landing pages required a real route change when removed, otherwise the heading and reload state disagreed.
repair: Apply pool, spa, accessibility, whole-place and online quick-filter state locally.
Synchronize shareable URL state with history.pushState after the local paint and preserve scroll position.
Give the exact clicked control synchronous aria-busy, disabled and spinner feedback before catalog recomputation.
Route only semantic landing-default removal to the generic search page after the immediate pending paint.

family.wholePlace: shared implementation and source contract passed; control absent from exact local catalog fixture

verification.eslint: 0 errors; one pre-existing exhaustive-deps warning at app/search/page.tsx

release.reason: The current request authorized repair and speed improvement but did not explicitly authorize this release to production.
